<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0232026-10-0503-33-35" status="unreviewed">des na snang myi snang rdzas gnyis myed par 'grub pa yin no <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya pa</rs></note> zhes gsung ba ni legs par mi sems te | skad cig ma snang ba
               <lb n="25a6"/>  kad cig ma la ltos te snang la ma nges pa brjod pa yin na ci skad cig ma'i ldom pa la ltos ta 'am rdzas la ltos te | nga po ltar na rkyad cig ma myi snag ba'i ldog pa yin ba ma khegs pas ldog pa snang bar nges pa'i tshad ma myed pa'i phyir nges pa'i tha snyad du myi brjod par 'gyur la | gnyis pa ltar na skad cig ma'i rdzas dang sngon po'i rdzas gcig pas sngon po'i rdzas kyang snang la ma nges pa'i
               <lb n="25a7"/>yul yin pas tshad mas ma gzhal bar 'gyur ro || </seg></TEI>
